name: Unique Woodworking
old_description: Unique Woodworking is a Las Vegas based custom woodwork shop. We are practiced in building all types of custom built cabinetry. We specialize in creating versatile designs that not only fit a specific space but also integrate functional features that suit your lifestyle.
about:
Unique Woodworking operates a custom woodwork shop in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company focuses on building all types of custom cabinetry, offering versatile designs that integrate functional features for specific spaces. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop maintains a 3,000-square-foot production facility where skilled artisans construct cabinetry using high-quality materials. The company offers a diverse range of design choices in woods, laminates, finishes, mouldings, and hardware, allowing for extensive customization. Production speed is noted as a priority in its operations, enabling timely project completion.

Unique Woodworking serves clients seeking custom cabinetry for residential and commercial projects. The company does not specify particular industries but works with customers who require tailored woodwork solutions, including homeowners, contractors, and designers.

The company emphasizes its commitment to quality and customer service, stating that its custom woodwork exceeds expectations. It also highlights production speed as a competitive factor, aiming to deliver projects efficiently.
